text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When you identify bugs in your code, the first step is to understand exactly what is going wrong. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you examine your program closely. However, tools alone are not enough. You also need a systematic approach: reproduce the problem, isolate the cause, and test your fix carefully. Logging is another powerful strategy. By adding log messages to your code, you can track what happens while the program runs and find where errors appear. With patience and the right methods, you can solve almost any bug.
